children: Al Moammar Information Systems Company (MIS) has signed an agreement with HUMAIN, a Public Investment Fund’s AI venture, to expand the planned capacity of the AI-focused data centre from 50 megawatts (MW) to 250 MW.
The agreement value exceeds 689 percent of the company’s total revenue in 2025, MIS said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.
Revenue stood at 1.27 billion Saudi riyals ($338.21 million) in 2025. Likewise, 689 percent of that amount equals SAR 8.75 billion ($2.33 billion).
Engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) works will be carried out under work orders issued by HUMAIN in accordance with the terms of the agreement.
MIS had signed a contract with HUMAIN in March 2025 worth more than 155 percent of the company’s total 2024 revenue. The new agreement replaces the earlier contract, the statement said.
